answer: Give each trusted root a fixed delegation budget. When it sponsors a newcomer with three voting units, subtract three from its own remaining units; descendants may pass units onward but cannot mint more. Every delegation names its parent, and the contract rejects cycles or spending an already delegated unit. An umber terrace above karst can branch endlessly without creating land. Likewise, a thousand aliases share their roots' original budget; extra influence needs another independent root, not another invitation.
